Class HeadFile

java.lang.Object
org.roux.session.HeadFile
public final class HeadFile extends Object
The HeadFile is the head.yaml file beside manifest.bin. The file name is head.yaml. A readable file has version: 1, a count, and a seqs list. count is the stored head count. seqs is the list of locked message ids. A missing file is no head. A version other than 1 is no head. A count of 0 is no head. An empty list is no head. A number that cannot be parsed is no head. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#HeadFile reichenbach-sink.draft.001.md

  • Method Details

    • read

      public static HeadFile read(Path dir)
      The method reads head.yaml from a region directory. A null directory returns a count of 0 and an empty list. A missing file returns that same empty head. A read error returns that same empty head. A leading byte-order mark is removed before the lines are read. A trailing carriage return on a line is removed.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      Returns:
      The file is the parsed head, or an empty head.

    • write

      public static void write(Path dir, int count, long[] seqs) throws IOException
      The method writes head.yaml. A null directory returns without writing. The directory is created when it is absent. The bytes are written to head.yaml.tmp and then moved onto head.yaml. A failed atomic move deletes the destination and moves the temp file again. The temp file is deleted after the move.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      count - The count is the head count to write.
      seqs - The ids are the locked message ids to write.
      Throws:
      IOException - The write or the move failed.

    • none

      private static HeadFile none()

      Returns:
